verdict.rationale: Composio is an infrastructure/tooling platform that lets external AI agents and frameworks connect to tools, accounts, and MCP servers—it is not itself an AI assistant product with a built-in assistant to delegate tasks to. The evidence describes enabling other agents (Codex, Claude Code, custom agents) via CLI, MCP, and SDK, not a first-party assistant inside Composio itself, so this consumer-assistant axis is a category mismatch.
